source_note: Anthropic's best practices recommend putting the Bash commands Claude can't guess in CLAUDE.md. Both sides get the plain hard task prompts (h1-h4): the hard prompts name no build or test commands, so no edited prompt files are needed. The with side adds a 5-line CLAUDE.md written from base/frai's real package names and package.json scripts; every command in it was re-run on a copy of base/frai on 15 Sep 2026 (pnpm --filter frai build and pnpm --filter frai-gate build compile with tsc and leave git status clean, frai-core's build is a no-op echo, pnpm --filter <package> test runs vitest: frai-gate 11 passed, frai-core 26 passed and the 2 known failures, frai no test files). Checked against the four hard prompts and reference patches: the CLAUDE.md only lists commands and mentions nothing about field parsing, thresholds, .env handling, option parsing or import matching. Extra metric (npm/yarn attempts) comes from the saved permission denials and events, not from a checker. Task set and model changed on 15 Sep 2026 after the pilots (see PROTOCOL): t1, t2, t3 and h2 on Haiku 4.5, both sides.
